Why You Don't Have to Drive to Dubuque for Great Healthcare Anymore

Published May 16, 2026 4 min read By Jennifer Burds, DNP, ARNP

We get it. For a long time, if you lived in Peosta, Asbury, Cascade, Bankston, or anywhere else in western Dubuque County and needed to see a doctor, the answer was simple: get in the car and drive to Dubuque.

And honestly? That drive adds up. Between the time, the traffic, the parking, and the waiting rooms packed with people from across the region — it could turn a simple appointment into a half-day ordeal.

Here's the good news: you don't have to do that anymore.

Burds Family Practice is right here in Peosta, and we're offering the kind of comprehensive, high-quality care that used to mean a long commute. Here's why staying local is the smarter choice for you and your family.

1. Your Time Is Worth Something

Think about what it actually costs to drive into Dubuque for a doctor's appointment. By the time you factor in the drive there, finding parking, waiting to be seen, and driving home, you've easily spent two to three hours on what might be a 15-minute visit.

At Burds Family Practice, we're right in your backyard. You can pop in for a same-day appointment, actually be seen on time, and get back to your day — whether that's getting the kids from school, getting back to work, or just getting back to your life.

2. Smaller Practice = More Personalized Care

Big city clinics and large health systems are busy. Really busy. That often means shorter appointments, rotating providers, and a care experience that can feel rushed and impersonal.

At Burds Family Practice, we deliberately keep our practice community-sized. That means when you call, someone who knows you answers. When you come in, your provider remembers your history, your family, and your goals. You're not starting from scratch every visit — you're continuing a relationship.

That kind of continuity isn't just more pleasant. It's actually better medicine. Providers who know you over time catch things that get missed in one-off visits.

3. We Offer More Than You Might Expect

One of the biggest reasons people drive to larger cities is the assumption that more services are available there. And while that's true for highly specialized procedures, the everyday healthcare that most families need? We've got it right here.

At Burds Family Practice, we offer:

  • Primary Care for all ages — from newborns to seniors

  • Direct Primary Care (DPC) — a membership model with unlimited visits and direct access to your provider

  • Occupational Health — keeping workers and employers across the area covered

  • Medical Weight Loss — including semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound)

  • Infrared Sauna Therapy — for recovery, relaxation, and overall wellness

  • Medical Aesthetics — through SkinRx by Burds Family Practice

For the vast majority of what you and your family need, it's all right here in Peosta.

4. Local Providers Are Invested in This Community

There's a real difference between a provider who commutes to a clinic and one who actually lives and works in this community. Jenny Burds didn't open a practice in Peosta by accident — she chose this community because she believes in it.

When you see a local provider, you're supporting a business that sponsors local events, hires local staff, and genuinely cares about the health of your neighbors. That investment goes both ways.

5. Easier to Stay Consistent with Your Care

One of the biggest barriers to good health isn't access to a great doctor — it's the friction of actually getting there. When care is close, convenient, and relationship-based, people are more likely to keep their appointments, follow up when something feels off, and stay on top of preventive care.

That consistency is one of the most powerful things you can do for your long-term health. And it's a lot easier when your provider is 10 minutes away instead of 40.

When Should You Still Go to the City?

We believe in being honest with our patients. There are absolutely times when heading to a larger facility makes sense — major surgeries, highly specialized specialists, emergency trauma care. We'll always refer you to the right place when you need a level of care beyond what we provide.

But for your everyday health needs, your annual physicals, your chronic condition management, your kids' check-ups, your weight loss journey, and your wellness goals? You've got everything you need right here.

Come See Us in Peosta

We're proud to be the healthcare home for families across western Dubuque County — Peosta, Asbury, Cascade, Farley, Bankston, and beyond. If you've been putting off finding a local provider, let this be the nudge you needed.

Call us at (563) 588-6659, visit us at 8411 Peosta Commercial Ct Suite #8, Peosta, IA, or book online at burdsfamilypractice.com. We're accepting new patients and would love to welcome your family.
